aboutMe.title: Front-end Developer
paragraphs: Based in Azerbaijan 🇦🇿, I am an experienced Front-end Developer with a strong background in crafting engaging and responsive user interfaces. Proficient in a range of web technologies, I am dedicated to delivering visually appealing and user-friendly web applications that enhance the user experience and drive business growth.

experience.description: Lead developer for multiple large-scale government and financial projects. Key projects include the Internet Tax Administration (e-Portal), VAT Bank System, and MDM (Master Data Management).

As a Project Manager, I successfully led and managed a dynamic team of over 50 talented developers, testers, and analysts. Our primary focus was the conceptualization, design, and implementation of a cutting-edge Tax System aimed at simplifying and optimizing the tax payment process for taxpayers.

In 2016, I embarked on a remarkable journey founding a tech company, venturing into the competitive landscape alongside industry giants. During my tenure, my dedicated team and I achieved remarkable milestones, delivering two pivotal projects. We introduced an Online Educational Monitoring System for schools and implemented a Master Data Management solution for centralized data control across various systems.

Over a period of five years, I embarked on a progressive journey from an Operations Manager to eventually becoming the Executive Director of a transportation company. My responsibilities encompassed overseeing a fleet of vehicles and a team of dedicated drivers. We specialized in delivering ad-hoc transportation services and providing exceptional guest meet-and-greet experiences for esteemed clients such as BP, Statoil, Amec, and others.
